title: 3 AI updates: Code Mode, llama.cpp 1.0, Robotics #shorts
description:
3 AI updates in under a minute, in simple words.

1. Claude Code ka Code Mode (experimental, default me band): Claude har tool call ka result padhne ke bajaye JavaScript likhta hai jo kai tool calls ek hi step me chala deta hai.
2. llama.cpp 1.0: AI models apne computer par chalane wala tool. Ab API badalne par major version badlega, yaani developers ke liye zyada bharosa.
3. Gemini Robotics 2.5 (Google DeepMind): robots ke liye AI model. Google ke hisaab se purane baselines se 30% se 100% zyada success rate. Abhi sirf robotics partners ko mil raha hai.

Sources (official pages):
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode
https://huggingface.co/blog/ggml-org/llama-cpp-v1
https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robotics-2-5-accelerates-real-world-physical-intelligence/

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic, ggml or Google.

Note: page crops are our own capture of the official pages (key lines highlighted). Photos are free AI-generated illustrations, not real product shots. Synthetic voice.
